Figliomeni's Challenging the Mafia of Calabria is explicitly titled What Is Mafia-Type Organized Crime? and opens Part I, which defines organised crime and traces the emergence of mafia-type organised criminal groups in Southern Italy. The book analyses 'Ndrangheta's power structure, methods and regional influence in order to identify vulnerabilities for disruption.
